tagline: The world's leading elevator and escalator manufacturing, installation, service and modernization company
hero_kpi_rationale: The Service segment represents 91% of operating profit, making it the primary profitability driver despite contributing only 65% of sales. This is a key indicator of the business model's recurring value and sustainability.

kpis.name: Service Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from maintenance, repair, and modernization contracts for elevators and escalators.
kpis.description: The Service segment is the cornerstone of revenue, supported by a strong base of recurring contracts.
kpis.signal: 65% of sales come from service, a highly predictable recurring revenue stream.

kpis.name: New Equipment Segment Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue related to the design, manufacturing, and installation of new elevators and escalators.
kpis.description: This segment is highly dependent on new construction and infrastructure projects.
kpis.signal: 35% of sales, but more sensitive to real estate cycles.

kpis.name: Service Operating Profit
kpis.explanation: Profit generated from maintenance and modernization activities.
kpis.description: Despite a smaller share of revenue, service generates nearly all of the profit.
kpis.signal: 91% of operating profit comes from service: a high-margin recurring model.

kpis.name: New Equipment Operating Profit
kpis.explanation: Portion of operating profit from the sale and installation of new equipment.
kpis.description: This segment is capital-intensive and less profitable than service.
kpis.signal: Only 9% of profit, despite 35% of sales: low margins on new equipment.

kpis.name: UpLift Run-Rate Annual Savings
kpis.explanation: Annual savings expected from the operational model transformation.
kpis.description: The UpLift program aims to streamline the organization and reduce costs.
kpis.signal: $200M in annual savings by 2025, up from $120M in 2024.

kpis.name: International Sales
kpis.explanation: Share of sales generated outside the United States.
kpis.description: Otis operates in over 200 countries, with direct presence in 70+ countries.
kpis.signal: 71% of sales are international: strong global footprint.

kpis.name: UpLift Transformation Costs (total)
kpis.explanation: Total costs related to the implementation of the transformation program.
kpis.description: These costs include consultants, external services, and the rollout of the new operating model.
kpis.signal: $300M in total costs expected, with $69M incurred in 2025.

kpis.name: UpLift Pre-Tax Savings
kpis.explanation: Pre-tax savings achieved through the UpLift program.
kpis.description: Savings are primarily in general and administrative expenses.
kpis.signal: $70M in savings in both 2025 and 2024: stable run-rate.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale. Indicateur clé pour les investisseurs orientés revenus.
kpis.description: 5-year history of declared dividends per share (2021-2025).

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel du cash redistribué aux actionnaires : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions (treasury stock).
kpis.description: For 2025: cumulative dividends + share buybacks in billions USD.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du bénéfice net redistribuée en dividendes. Au-dessus de 80 % indique un dividende potentiellement non-soutenable.
kpis.description: Dividends / net income for 2025 (based on net income attributable to shareholders).

risks.title: Global Economic Conditions
risks.score_rationale: Overall economic conditions affect the company's entire business, including sales and profits. The source uses alarmist language with terms such as 'adversely affected' and 'material impact'.

risks.title: Geopolitical Risks
risks.score_rationale: Geopolitical conflicts, particularly the war between Russia and Ukraine explicitly mentioned in the source, can have significant consequences for the company's operations, especially regarding supply chains and costs.

risks.title: Supplier Dependence and Supply Chain
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on suppliers for raw materials and components necessary for production. Disruptions in the supply chain can have significant consequences.

risks.title: Technology and Cybersecurity Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company faces cybersecurity and data governance risks, particularly in the context of geopolitical threats and global technological disruptions.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive environment and must maintain its leadership position by offering competitive products and services.

risks.title: Emerging Markets Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in emerging markets, which carry political and economic stability risks, particularly in China where it has a significant presence.

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to regulations, particularly in safety, environmental protection, and climate compliance, which may impact its operations.

ai_positioning.summary: OTIS did not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or similar terms in the provided excerpts from its 10-K report. Therefore, its positioning on AI cannot be determined from this information.
